title: Weak-$A_\infty$ packing and estimates for fractional sparse forms on spaces of homogeneous type
summary: We prove two-weight estimates for fractional sparse forms on spaces of homogeneous type. The relevant transformed weights are assumed to belong to weak-$A_\infty$. The weak reverse Hölder inequality is normalized on enlarged balls, while sparse testing is normalized on dyadic cubes. To measure this loss, we introduce $\mathfrak d_Q^w:=w(Q)/w(2ΛB_Q)$. A packing estimate for the defect levels, combined with two-weight testing, gives the required mixed weak-$A_\infty$ bounds.
